reviews.t: Great for someone getting into DE shaving​
reviews.x: An ok razor to begin with. Great for someone getting into DE shaving​. I started with this razor shaving my head. Blade alignment can be a serious pain. Thus why this is a good razor to start with, it cause you to pay attention to detail which is very important. Razor is fairly mild, if you pay attention to detail and let the Blade do the work you can get a decent shave.

reviews.t: I had this product for three months and the handle ...
reviews.x: I had this product for three months and the handle will not tighten into the top potion of the safety plate, it seems that in a short time the threads became stripped,I was enjoying this razor until the handle would not tighten into the safety plate, in the future I will purchase a razor that opens up with out the handle having to come off to insert the razor blade into the razor

I really like this razor. I'm glad it has a longer handle; I think a shorter handle would be harder to hold. The balance is good, and it is easier to get the hang of shaving with it than I thought. I was skeptical that a single blade would shave closer than a multi-blade, but it really does! The Derby blades last about two weeks each.

reviews.t: It's a little more annoying than i thought it would be
reviews.x: It's held up for close to a year, no rust, but this was also my first experience with a safety razor, so take this with a grain of salt. As other reviewers have pointed out, the blade is of center. It's a little more annoying than i thought it would be, which is why i deducted a star, but overall I am happy with my purchase.

Have to say that it exceeded my expectations. The handle is nice and heavy and the head is between mild and aggressive. A very nice shave, well worth the $12. It wont be in my rotation not because of the razor itself, but because I have others. I'll keep it around for occasional use, or gift it to somebody more needy.

Very nice packaging.  Solid weight and easy to add and change blades.  Keep in mind, it's not a butterfly opener so the entire head piece must be removed to change blades; not a deal breaker.  Also note, 20 blades are included.  Works with standard duel edge razors found at Shoprite, etc.  Overall, a very nice razor.

bought this a few years ago. when i unscrewed the head there appeared to be seeds inside the handle??? like, maybe grass or flax seed. also my cat knocked it off the side of the tub, a little over a foot up, and it snapped and became unusable. pretty odd for something thats metal.

I will never go back to disposable razors again. I love this razor! It is so easy to use, beginner friendly and just made for a relaxing experience. As an African American woman I can say this really impressed me at how easy it was to use. I would recommend this to anyone any day.

reviews.t: This is a nice razor that does the job with no problems
reviews.x: This is a nice razor that does the job with no problems. It has the feel and looks of a much more expensive razor. I look forward to many years of use from using it. The 2 packs of blades are a bonus to keep from having to buy any blades soon. I am glad I made this purchase.

reviews.t: Blade doesn't stick out far enough to use
reviews.x: I bought it and you can't cut anything with it because the blade doesn't stick out far enough to shave, you couldn't draw blood with this thing if your life depended on it, not sure if mine is just not right but it would be impossible to shave with this razor.

Great item, seller shipped quickly and the item arrived in perfect condition. This razor gives one of the best/closest shaves ever. Cannot wait to use it with the right shaving supplies! Even without though I highly recommend it!

reviews.t: Nice razor, poor choice of blades.
reviews.x: Nice razor but don't like Derby blades. The first shave was not good. Next time I will try a feather or Gillette blade in hopes of a better result. I would say it is a good razor for one starting out in wet shaving.

This razor was an excellent value! Bought it for $8 two years ago and it served me very well until the screw post broke off last week. Quality but for the obvious is on par with my name brand replacement.

reviews.t: I purchased another one from someone different to compare & this one feels like plastic while the other feels like metal
reviews.x: It's not heavy enough for me. I purchased another one from someone different to compare & this one feels like plastic while the other feels like metal. I gave it 3 stars because it does the job.
Not sure I am ready for 1 blade.  Have been using dual bladed devices for many years. I got 4 nicks in 8 shaves. One deep nick by not paying attention. This blade might be too aggressive!
Very nice razor. Smooth shave and solid feel. Buy this one instead of butterfly opening. That butterfly mechanism will break over time this one will serve you years after years.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it a good value and a solid choice for the price, with some saying it exceeded expectations.
Several reviewers report blade alignment problems, with the blade sitting off-center or one edge protruding more than the other.
It is frequently described as a good beginner/first safety razor that is fairly mild and not overly aggressive.
Some reviewers experienced durability issues, with the threads wearing out or stripping so the handle would no longer tighten.
A few reviewers were disappointed, reporting the blade barely reaches the edge or calling it a total waste.
